technical.summary: Bullish structure with price above all key MAs and new highs, but overbought oscillators and weak ADX trend strength combined with below-average volume limit conviction for swing entry.

fundamental.summary: FANG shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 40 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No congressional signal with stale trades (400+ days old); Fear index (42) presents contrarian opportunity but insufficient conviction from political insiders or recent news to confirm.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis (407.84), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and macro_score of -4 create severely unfavourable conditions; 40-day earnings adds moderate event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with Hull flip and 20-day new high provides bullish structure, and fear index (42) offers contrarian opportunity in oversold sentiment.
debate.key_bear_argument: Extreme VIX crisis (407.84), unfavourable macro environment (macro_score -4), overbought oscillators with weak ADX trend conviction, zero fundamental support, and below-average volume create a high-risk, low-conviction setup despite technical structure.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure is bullish with price above all major MAs and new 20-day highs, but this is severely undermined by extreme macro headwinds (VIX crisis 407.84, macro_score -4) and zero fundamental conviction.
decision.primary_risk: Extreme VIX environment and unfavourable macro conditions create systemic downside risk that outweighs technical bullish setup; overbought oscillators with weak ADX trend strength increase reversal probability near resistance.
